name: subst_self
statement: subst (MvPowerSeries.X : σ → MvPowerSeries σ R) = id

have_tree.body: aeval_unique (ε := AlgHom.id R (MvPowerSeries σ R)) continuous_id

name: coeff_subst
statement: HasSubst a) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) (e : τ →₀ ℕ) : coeff e (subst a f) = finsum (fun d ↦ coeff d f • (coeff e (d.prod fun s e => (a s) ^ e)))

name: eval₂_subst
statement: HasSubst a) {b : τ → T} (hb : HasEval b) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) : eval₂ (algebraMap S T) b (subst a f) = eval₂ (algebraMap R T) (fun s ↦ eval₂ (algebraMap S T) b (a s)) f
